en.about_body: **DecayCore** is a room correction FIR generator for DSP systems that support FIR filters. - **Author:** Vilho Valittu - **Contact:** 📧 [vilho.valittu@gmail.com](mailto:vilho.valittu@gmail.com) - **Community testing & feedback:** Patu - **Special Thanks:** OCA youtube.com/@ocaudiophile ☕ **Support development:** ko-fi.com/vilhovalittu
en.brand_subtitle: Measure the room. Reveal the music.
en.maintenance_intro: Recovery actions for when automatic mode behaves oddly or you want a clean start. Your measurements, saved target presets and exported filters are never removed.
en.maintenance_clear_caches_dialog_body: Removes the Optuna search journals, the automatic-mode result cache and the learned filter priors. The next automatic run recomputes everything from scratch, so it will take longer. Your settings are kept.
en.maintenance_reset_settings_dialog_body: Discards every setting you have changed, including the selected mode, target curve, file paths and the light/dark theme. The page reloads immediately with factory defaults. Automatic-mode caches are kept.
en.maintenance_caches_already_clean: No automatic-mode caches found — nothing to clear.
en.maintenance_partial_failure: {removed} file(s) removed, {failed} could not be deleted. See the log for details.
en.maintenance_blocked_during_run: A run is in progress. Wait for it to finish before using maintenance actions.
en.auto_taps_body: Similar filter duration at every sample rate.
en.bass_first_enable_label: Enable Bass-first AI (do not smooth room modes away)
en.stereo_auto_policy_help: Allows separate L/R bass limits below this frequency.
en.bass_integration_auto_help: Creates main/sub FIRs and CamillaDSP crossover settings. Prioritizes phase alignment.
en.bass_integration_packaged_only_help: Available only in the packaged app.
en.bass_integration_mode_direct_only: Mode: Direct DAC / CamillaDSP sub output
en.bass_integration_requires_wav: Requires separate main/sub WAV impulse measurements.
en.bass_integration_wav_format: Mono float32 IRs. Use the same gain and timing reference. Do not normalize or shift files separately.
en.bass_integration_exports_lr_only: Generates only normal L/R FIR filters.
en.bass_integration_playback_match: Use the same acoustic timing reference for all main/sub measurements.
en.bass_integration_main_hpf_help: Main HPF belongs to the Direct DAC main/sub crossover model.
en.bi_direct_sub_help: Load one or two mono sub IRs.
en.bass_integration_direct_playback_match: Uses main HPF and sub LPF. Keep the same timing reference for all measurements.
en.bass_integration_xo_phase_model_info: XO settings describe the main speaker crossover / HPF phase model.
en.bass_integration_xo_avr_separate_info: Bass Integration uses the Direct DAC main/sub crossover configured in Basic / Auto.
en.sub_integration_help: AVR: adds HPF to L/R. Direct DAC: can also create a mono Sub FIR.
en.sub_integration_enable: Enable Sub Integration (apply HPF to L/R)
en.sub_crossover_manual_override: Override auto XO with manual value
en.sub_crossover_auto_help: Auto selects the main HPF and may raise the sub LPF for better summation.
en.bass_integration_allpass_auto_help: Optimizes sub phase near the crossover. CamillaDSP export only.
en.sub_generate_ir: Generate Sub WAV (direct DAC / CamillaDSP connection)
en.guide_exc_prot_body: Limits risky bass boost from the measurement and target. Recommended for small woofers and bass-heavy targets.
en.guide_low_bass_cut_body: Blocks boost below the selected frequency. Cuts remain allowed. Always on in Basic mode.
en.input_files_help: .txt: frequency response. .wav: impulse response. Use Measure for guided capture.
en.files_export_rates_help: Selected rate or all playback rates.
en.measurement_library_help: .txt/.wav folder. File names can suggest channels.
en.measurement_library_status_empty: No .txt or .wav measurements were found in this folder.
en.measurement_intro: Microphone, output, and channel. 48 kHz, -12 dBFS sweep.
en.measurement_volume_attenuation_hint: Set volume at the amplifier or analog control. Earlier digital attenuation reduces SNR.
en.measurement_actions_section_intro: Test, capture, or start a guided session.
en.measurement_dither_level_hint: Wakes devices that mute on digital silence. Ends before the timing chirp.
en.measurement_source_hint: Optional stereo WAV: left = timing reference, right = sweep.
en.measurement_sub_output_channel_hint: Linux: sub sweep output for virtual 2.1/PCM devices.
en.measurement_sub_bass_integration_notice: Auto Bass Integration: apply sub measurements directly.
en.ir_export_window_help_long: Impulse shaping. Hann reduces ringing; Tukey preserves more bass. Target unchanged.
en.ir_window_left_label: Left window (ms). Asymmetric: sets target peak position (latency).
en.ir_window_right_label: Right window (ms). Asymmetric: radius uses max(L/R).
en.auto_optimize_low_bass_cut: Optimize low-bass cut in auto mode
en.lvl_manual_help: Target average within the level-matching window.
en.manual_target_tilt_help: Pivots at 1 kHz. Positive adds bass; negative adds treble.
en.manual_target_tilt_drag_hint: Tip: drag the orange tilt handle on the right side of the preview.
en.output_tilt_help: Applies Manual Tilt after correction. Advanced + Manual mode only.
en.lvl_manual_bias_hint: Manual mode: 0.0 dB is neutral. Lower values = less bass, higher values = more bass.
en.lvl_manual_drag_hint_curve: Tip: drag the target curve in the preview.
en.mode_advanced_desc: No mode limits. Verify the result.
en.mode_auto_desc: Searches presets and selects a filter. Runtime depends on your computer.
en.auto_mode_packaged_only_help: Automatic mode requires the packaged app. Basic and Advanced remain available.
en.mode_apply_defaults_help: Replaces current values with mode defaults.
en.mode_basic_desc: Safe limits and cuts-first correction. Recommended.
en.auto_score_context_notice: Compare scores only within this measurement set.
en.auto_target_mode_adaptive: Adaptive: derive target from room acoustics
en.auto_target_mode_selected: Use selected target curve from Target page
en.multi_rate: Generate all common filter sample rates. 8 GB RAM recommended.
en.multi_rate_ultra_high: Also include 352.8 and 384 kHz export rates. 16 GB RAM recommended.
en.path_l_main: OR Local Path Left main only
en.path_r_main: OR Local Path Right main only
en.stat_measurement_read_failed: Measurement read failed. Check the L/R files on the Files tab, then run again.
en.tab_xo_help: Crossover filters only. No room correction. Leave unused slots empty.
en.taps_warn_over: ⚠️ Over 131072 taps: high latency and CPU use.
en.file_slot_manual_expand: Load file or enter path manually
en.wav_recommended_info: ⚠️ Use mono float32 WAVs with the same gain and timing reference. Do not normalize files separately.
en.target_preview_legend_hint: Click a legend item to hide it. Double-click to isolate it.
en.target_curve_download_tooltip: Saves the displayed green curve with manual level and tilt.
en.target_curve_download_unavailable: The current target preview could not be exported.
en.target_decay_hint_summary_caution: Possible bass decay or resonance risk.
en.target_decay_hint_summary_strong: Strong bass decay or resonance risk.
en.target_decay_hint_body_no_data: RT60 or harmonic metadata is missing.
en.target_decay_hint_body_rt60_caution: Slow bass decay. Avoid forcing a flat low end.
en.target_decay_hint_body_harmonic_caution: Elevated bass resonance risk. Prefer cuts.
en.target_decay_hint_body_mixed_caution: Decay and resonance risk. Keep bass correction conservative.
en.target_decay_hint_body_rt60_strong: Long bass decay. Do not boost deep nulls.
en.target_decay_hint_body_harmonic_strong: Strong bass resonance risk. Avoid aggressive shaping.
en.target_decay_hint_body_mixed_strong: Likely room-driven bass problem, not a target mismatch.
en.target_decay_hint_body_avoid_nulls: Do not boost deep bass nulls.
en.ui_plots_visual_only: Plots – display only (no effect on output)
en.hybrid_iir_help: Moves verified narrow bass cuts to CamillaDSP PEQ.
en.health_target_curve_upload_missing: No uploaded target file or local target path found.
en.health_bass_integration_auto_only: Bass Integration works only in AUTO mode.
en.health_bass_engine_unavailable: Packaged Bass Integration engine is unavailable.
en.health_bass_integration_wav_only_missing: Main and sub measurements must be WAV. Sub 2 is optional.
en.health_bass_integration_missing: Add L/R main and Sub 1 WAVs. Sub 2 is optional.
en.health_main_hpf_unusual: Main HPF is unusual; verify the Direct DAC main/sub crossover.
en.health_bass_integration_playback_match: Match playback and measurement settings, especially the sub crossover.
en.health_measurements_missing: No measurement sources found. Upload both L/R or set both local paths.
en.health_measurements_missing_pair: Measurement source is incomplete. Provide both L and R from the same source.
en.health_correction_range_invalid: Correction range invalid. mag_c_min must be < mag_c_max.
en.health_correction_max_very_high: High correction limit. Above ~300 Hz results depend more on the speaker and measurement.
en.health_correction_range_set_bounds: Correction range. Set min and max for FIR-correction.
en.health_taps_count_high: Taps count is high. May affect AV sync / usability.
en.health_engine_metrics_set: Engine metrics. Set fs and taps.
en.health_leveling_range_invalid: Leveling range invalid. lvl_min must be < lvl_max.
en.health_leveling_range_narrow: Leveling range is narrow. Level estimate may be unstable.
en.health_max_boost_high: Max boost is high. Will stress drivers and amplifier.
en.health_phase_limit_high: Phase correction limit is high. Above ~800 Hz correction may cause audible artifacts.
en.health_excursion_protection_off: Excursion protection is OFF. Recommended to keep it enabled to protect bass drivers.
en.health_hpf_freq_invalid: HPF enabled but frequency is invalid.
en.health_hpf_freq_high: HPF frequency is very high vs sample rate.
en.health_hpf_slope_invalid: HPF enabled but slope/order is invalid.
en.health_mixed_split_invalid: Mixed filter split frequency is invalid.
en.health_mixed_split_low: Mixed split is very low. Effect may be minimal.
en.health_mixed_split_high: Mixed split is very high vs sample rate.
en.health_transition_width_wider: Transition width is wider than split frequency.
en.window_temporal_processing_intro: A-FDW limits correction; TDC limits decay.
en.toast_tdc_preset_locked_auto: TDC preset locked in AUTO mode
en.toast_adv_preset_locked_auto: Advanced preset locked in AUTO mode
en.toast_afdw_preset_locked_auto: A-FDW preset locked in AUTO mode
en.results_plot_quality_unavailable: Confidence or A-FDW data is unavailable for this channel.
en.results_plot_phase_title: Unwrapped phase trend in the corrected band (bulk delay removed)
en.results_plot_group_delay_title: Group delay in the corrected band before / after correction
en.results_plot_impulse_title: Final FIR impulse near the main peak
en.results_download_description: Download the ZIP to this device.
en.results_download_unavailable: The generated filter bundle is unavailable.
en.results_auto_diag_summary: **Winner:** {target} | rank score: {rank:.3f} | avg score: {avg:.3f} | boost: {boost:.2f} dB | trials: {ok}/{total}
en.bass_integration_dsp_settings_note: Enter these exact values in your DSP crossover / delay / polarity settings.
en.results_value_bass_metric_channel_mode_w: Worst of L-only, R-only, and correlated mono-center
en.results_value_bass_shared_sub_branch: One shared mono Sub FIR plus one shared delay/gain/polarity/allpass set drive both subwoofers.
en.results_value_bass_xo_main_sub_gd_assess: {delta} ms -> good. <1.5 ms good, <5 ms average, 5-8 ms elevated, >8 ms consider repositioning sub(s).
{delta} ms -> average. <1.5 ms good, <5 ms average, 5-8 ms elevated, >8 ms consider repositioning sub(s).
{delta} ms -> elevated. <1.5 ms good, <5 ms average, 5-8 ms elevated, >8 ms consider repositioning sub(s).
{delta} ms -> consider repositioning sub(s). <1.5 ms good, <5 ms average, 5-8 ms elevated, >8 ms consider repositioning sub(s).

en.auto_detail_protection_seed_fallback: Bass limit measurement was unreliable — preserving {hz} Hz, low-cut: {lc} Hz, excursion seed: {exc} Hz

en.auto_detail_target_shortlist: Room curve shortlist: {sel}/{total} curves selected (spread {spread} dB)
en.auto_detail_phase1_done: Search complete — ripple {ripple} dB, {ok} of {run} candidates usable
en.auto_detail_local_refine: Local refinement {n} complete — {ok} of {run} candidates usable
en.auto_detail_micro_refine_start: Final tuning starting — {trials} trials around the current best
en.auto_detail_micro_refine: Final tuning complete — {ok} of {run} candidates usable
en.auto_detail_phase3_skipped: Final tuning skipped — nothing left to improve
en.auto_detail_target_from_cache: Room curve from cache — {target} (same measurements, skipping comparison)
en.auto_detail_preset_from_cache: Preset from cache — target: {target}, extra micro-trials: {rounds}×{trials}
en.auto_detail_cache_refine_init: Cache refinement — up to {rounds} rounds, {trials} trials/round
en.auto_detail_local_refine_fallback: Local refinement {n} — retried with relaxed limits
en.auto_detail_micro_refine_fallback: Final tuning — retried with relaxed limits
en.auto_reason_boost_safety: limited by the boost safety margin near a room peak

en.auto_detail_adaptive_target_fallback: Room curve fell back to a conservative shape ({reason})
en.auto_detail_stereo_lf_policy: Stereo bass protection applied — {side} channel below {hz} Hz
en.auto_detail_target_cache_seed: Reusing the room curve from the previous run
en.auto_detail_custom_target_missing: Custom target file not found — using built-in room curves
en.rust_warning_body: The optional public Rust DSP extension is missing, so manual filtering uses the slower Python fallback.
en.session_guided_desc: Capture repeated measurements across one or more listening positions.
en.session_sub_slots_note: Sub 1 and Sub 2 are applied to the existing subwoofer slots.
en.target_curve_save_preset_tooltip: Save the current target curve as a named preset for reuse
en.target_curve_save_preset_empty_name: Enter a name for the preset
en.target_curve_save_preset_duplicate_name: A preset with this name already exists
en.target_curve_save_preset_unavailable: The current target curve could not be saved
